Psalms

Introduction

Psalm, (is) one (lot) of collected songs, other songs, poems, and prayers. People of Israil used that in their worshiping. Then, they added them on their Writing_Documents.

There (are) many kinds of these doings of believers of God (MS Manama): there (are) songs to praise and worship God, there (are) also prayers for asking_for_help, and for salvation, asking forgiveness, songs of thanksgiving for the blessings of God, and request that their enemies will_be punished. These prayers both for one person and for the entire place; some, (are) showing desire to a person, some, (are) informing the needs and love to all the people of God.

Jesus used songs, the writers included (it) in the New News, and this reading_document is cared to worship in the Church of the believers from the beginning.

played(pl) with tambourine and zithers your(pl) praising.

4 The Lord God is_happy with his people;

he caused_to_be_great those who (are) humble, by getting_ them _to_win.

5 It (is) fitting that people of God will_rejoice because of their victory;

cause_ them _to_sing because of joy, even in their lying_down_places.

6 Cause_ them _to_shout to praise God,

while rising their weapons,

7 to avenge the nations; to punish the people.

8 They bind the kings with a chain and the leaders of their enemies.

9 The kings will_be_punished according to the commands of God.

That (is) the glory for faithful people of God!
